[[Corporal]] '''Kimzi''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[communications officer]]. He was assigned to the [[Aldhani Garrison|garrison]] on [[Aldhani]] during the [[Imperial Era|height]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Axe" />

==Biography==
During the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] Kimzi served as the [[Communications officer|comms officer]] at the [[Aldhani dam|Imperial outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[Corporal]]. The outpost was a dam that stood at the side of a [[mountain]] in Aldhani's [[Highlands (Aldhani)|highlands]].<ref name="Eye" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the outpost was expecting a visit from<ref name="Axe" /> [[Colonel]] [[Soden Petigar|Petigar]],<ref name="Eye" /> an Imperial engineering [[Imperial officer|officer]] who operated from the<ref name="Axe" /> [[capital]] world of<ref name="Coruscant DB">{{Databank|coruscant|Coruscant}}</ref> [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Axe" /> who was there to draw out plans for a new facility.<ref name="Eye" /> Kimzi heard rumors that the dam itself would be demolished as a result and discussed them with [[Lieutenant]] [[Gorn]].<ref name="Axe" /> He discovered a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|team]] of infiltrators conducting a raid on the garrison's payroll and personally lead a squad down to the vault, where he was [[Death|killed]] by [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] after shooting Gorn for being a [[spy]].<ref name="Eye" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kimzi was portrayed by [[Nick Blood]] in the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''.<ref name="Axe" />
